title: Fix HttpContentEncoder does not handle multiple Accept-Encoding

timeline.message: Fix HttpContentEncoder does not handle multiple Accept-Encoding headers correctly
timeline.author: Andrey Mizurov

timeline.body:
Motivation:
At the current moment `HttpContentEncoder` handle only first value of multiple `accept-encoding` headers.

Modification:

Join multiple `accept-encoding` headers to one separated by comma.

Result:

Fixes #9553
Can one of the admins verify this patch?
I wonder if we should optimise this a but to only build the StringBuilder etc when there are at least 2 elements in ?

reply.body: This could also be simplified to just `new StringBuilder(elements.next())`.

timeline.body: Better to just return `builder`, no need to copy to a `String` yet

It's a shame that `HttpHeaders` doesn't have `get`/`getAll` methods which return `CharSequence`s rather than `String`s. These would be quite easy to add I think and would help cut down on copying and garbage.

(this is a passing comment and not directly related to the PR change!)

timeline.author: Andrey Mizurov

timeline.body: @wilkinsona would you please check this one as well ?
LGTM and fixes the behaviour of the reproducer.
